'''SD''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] at [[Ania Solo]]'s [[Ania Solo's junkyard|junk yard]] that served as Ania's security and enforcer, throwing out any unruly customers and protecting the property.<ref name="Legacy 2" /> It was destroyed by [[Darth Wredd]], who was impersonating [[Yalta Val]], when the imposter attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Ania and [[Sauk]]. [[Gesaw rat]]s promptly began gnawing on its severed circuits, distracting the fake Val's thugs and allowing the pair to escape.<ref name="Legacy 1">[[Legacy (2013) 1|''Legacy'' (2013) 1]]</ref>
